question:
Two orientations of a dice are shown. This dice can be obtained by folding which of the option figures along the lines?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/797105ecfcd08aa67f77faf4c7cf23eb775c3b846ed61d623a4bb16e89c9cb6e.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

From the given two different cubes the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As $ is common on both the dice. It is clear that &, @, # and % are adjacent to it remaining number i.e., $ is will be opposite to G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f55124ad7ce42e0b39edf7737028bf6916f4935c32bf9c6a110e3ee7b84d3198.png] 

**Opposite pairs: **

@ → %

& → #

$ → G

Let check each option one by one.

Option 1) 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d7252fca0c77f8a4989d10641259ce3db61faa54a6f777b5baf0297dad7de48.png] 

Here,$ is opposite to # so it is False.

Option 2) 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b504b0c21fad98fa5c4815405f015dac7d68bfb6741e891bbb84bcec8ea9019.png] 

Here, & is opposite to $ so it is False.

Option 3)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41e2b6ad18e89251119a24a39669bff264ad33dfb6864f63cdf3827a23ebe474.png] 

Here, & is opposite to @ so it is False.

Option 4)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8682d9dd8f779244e52aeaa56178256df3bd7e3a365fe1a4e58daf8e8f537f18.png] 

Here, all the sign are correctly opposite according to the given dice so it is True.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
